title: Reducedness kills the complementary diagonal block
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], $j:Z\to Y$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $M,N$ finite free sheaves of ranks $m,n$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], with chosen bases $e_M,e_N$, and $\phi:M\to N$. Fix $a\in\mathbb N$ and an open $U\subseteq Z$. Assume that for every $z\in U$ there is a field $R$ and a morphism $g:\operatorname{Spec}R\to Y$ with image exactly $\{j(z)\}$ for which the matrix of $\phi$ evaluated by $g^\sharp$ has rank at most $a$ [def-weil-matrix-rank]. Suppose given isomorphisms $e_S:(j^*M)|_U\simeq\mathcal O_U^a\oplus\mathcal O_U^{m-a}$ and $e_T:(j^*N)|_U\simeq\mathcal O_U^a\oplus\mathcal O_U^{n-a}$, an automorphism $f$ of $\mathcal O_U^a$, and a morphism $\delta:\mathcal O_U^{m-a}\to\mathcal O_U^{n-a}$, with $(j^*\phi)|_U=e_T^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(f,\delta)e_S$. Then $\delta=0$. Here pullback, restriction and biproduct are those of [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits, def-weil-additive-category]. This conclusion only concerns the given complementary block and does not construct any neighbourhood or bases.

proof.text: The open immersion j identifies Z with an open subscheme of reduced Y, so Z and U are reduced (Mathlib isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion). Apply residue-field detection to δ on U.

For each x∈U specialize hrank at its underlying point x.1 with membership x.2, and apply the pointwise complementary-block residue theorem to the given bases, invertible f, δ and diagonal equality. This supplies the residue matrix vanishing required by detection.

lean.statement:
theorem complementary_block_eq_zero_of_rank_le
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {M N : Y.Modules} {m n : ℕ}
    (eM : M ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
    (eN : N ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
    (φ : M ⟶ N) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a : ℕ) (U : Z.Opens)
    (hrank : ∀ z : Z, z ∈ U →
      ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsField R) (g : Spec R ⟶ Y),
        Set.range g.base = {j.base z} ∧
        ((freeMatrix (eM.inv ≫ φ ≫ eN.hom)).map g.appTop).rank ≤ a)
    (eS : ((Modules.pullback j).obj M).restrict U.ι ≅
      free (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) ⊞ free (ULift.{u} (Fin (m - a))))
    (eT : ((Modules.pullback j).obj N).restrict U.ι ≅
      free (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) ⊞ free (ULift.{u} (Fin (n - a))))
    (f : free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) ⟶
      free (ULift.{u} (Fin a))) [IsIso f]
    (δ : free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (m - a))) ⟶
      free (ULift.{u} (Fin (n - a))))
    (hform : (restrictFunctor U.ι).map ((Modules.pullback j).map φ) =
      eS.hom ≫ biprod.map f δ ≫ eT.inv) : δ = 0
